title: RB1 TIME-REFERENCE Restricted Numerical/Formal T0-T7 Authority

capability.scope: Restricted reference-Richards temporal indicator, explicit head-budget normalization, model-certificate acceptance and bounded transactional retry semantics already admitted to RB1.

F_SI24.role: analytic and owner-verified bounded stiffness-aware indicator basis
F_SI24.exact_linear_scope: M*u_dot + A*u = 0 with constant SPD M, constant SPSD A and backward Euler over dt>0

F_VQ30.role: independent held-out qualification of the fixed F-SI24 indicator candidate and exact manufactured linear reproduction

F_SI25.role: production solver-owned accepted-state operator and indicator seam

F_VQ34.role: fresh independent qualification of remediated explicit-budget production policy binding

T0.rationale: RB1-TIME-REFERENCE is a numerical temporal-control capability, not an independently modelled physical phenomenon. Physical-process phenomena belong to the composed process capabilities.

T1.meaning: Controlled rationale exists for a backward-Euler temporal defect/head indicator, its explicit dimensionless head-budget normalization and fail-closed model-certificate use. The exact true-error theorem is limited to the stated constant linear dissipative semi-discrete scope; nonlinear B1.10 evidence is transfer/consistency evidence, not a general true-error theorem.

T2.meaning: Conceptual model: a converged Richards candidate is observed without changing its principal state; previous accepted right-derivative history plus current endpoint derivative feed a model-owned temporal indicator; an explicitly supplied valid H_budget normalizes B_inf to C_h; unavailable/invalid prerequisites fail closed.

relations: u_dot_np1=(u_np1-u_n)/dt for the accepted-state/candidate endpoint derivative representation used by the implementation
J_BE*delta=(M/dt)*e_raw within the admitted indicator construction
B_inf=B_M/sqrt(m_min) for positive diagonal M in the qualified construction
H_budget must be explicitly supplied, finite and >0 in cm pressure head
certificate validity additionally requires qualified temporal history and an available finite nonnegative B_inf
model-certificate acceptance boundary is C_h<=1 after hard mass acceptance

T4.meaning: SWAP-specific admitted envelope is the reference Richards legacy binding with explicit fixed-flux top boundary, bottom mode 5, no macropore operator, no active root-sink provider, admitted B1.10 head-independent source/sink semantics, conductivity_implicit_mode=0 and conductivity_mean_method=1. Unsupported routes return indicator unavailable/fail closed rather than silently changing physics.

T5.meaning: The controlled continuous/semi-discrete numerical basis is M*u_dot+A*u=0 with constant SPD M and constant SPSD A for the exact-linear theorem scope. Backward-Euler endpoint error is bounded by the fixed F-SI24 construction in that scope. This tier does not elevate the nonlinear production indicator to a general nonlinear true-error upper bound; nonlinear evidence remains finite-comparator consistency/transfer only.

T6.meaning: Time discretisation is generic backward-Euler trial stepping over dt=t1-t0>0 with qualified previous accepted right-derivative history. Rejected model-certificate trials use bounded transactional retry with reduced attempt dt; no day boundary and no theorem of monotone C_h improvement under shorter dt is assumed.

T7.meaning: Method authority: solve candidate from checkpoint, require hard mass gate first, require available finite nonnegative certificate and C_h<=1, otherwise rollback and bounded retry, and commit candidate state only after all acceptance gates pass. No default H_budget is supplied.

remaining_open_dependencies: Application-specific H_budget selection and total temporal/groundwater head-accuracy budget remain external policy/application evidence.
T12 independent application validation remains open.
Controlled WR-QA-2024 source and exact reconciliation remain open.
Physical-science and hybrid T0-T7 authority families remain separate work.
Whole-capability T8-T10 and any still-open complete T11 requirements remain governed by the existing traceability gap registry.
Surface-evaporation throughput/scaling and call-local allocation performance remain separate work.
hard_nonclaims: No production source, reference data, physics, solver, scientific tolerance, mass criterion, temporal acceptance or performance policy is changed by F-DOC13.
No numeric or default H_budget is selected, recommended or qualified for an application.
No universal temporal tolerance or groundwater-head accuracy budget is established.
B_inf and C_h are not promoted to general nonlinear true-error upper bounds.
No shorter-dt monotonicity theorem is claimed.
No unsupported bootstrap, restart-history reconstruction, forcing/event/topology continuation or coupling-window scope is added.
No capability is promoted to FULLY_TRACED and no Status A or Status AA readiness/compliance is claimed.
RB1 science, qualification and release authorities remain immutable.
